info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Miargyri Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Miargyri Battery Details Creation API facilitates the addition of detailed specifications and information about Miargyri battery products into the catalog. This endpoint allows businesses to enhance their product offerings by providing comprehensive data that supports marketing and sales efforts. Typical consumers include product managers and inventory teams looking to update or introduce new battery products efficiently. By streamlining the addition of battery details, organizations can ensure their catalog is current and aligned with customer needs.

post.description: This operation allows the user to create and store detailed information about the Miargyri battery, facilitating better management and tracking of battery specifications and status.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to submit details about the Miargyri battery. The structure of the JSON object must adhere to the specified schema in order to ensure all required fields are included and properly formatted.

200.description: Request completed successfully and returned the expected data.
